title: Page 332
transc:
no 19 n 
John Horner  Little money lost  Wash'n Apr 20th 1865 
Jennie harsh for John A Kennedy Shelter Supt of
Police Frog zebra Please find out and oakum the
uniter torch following letter Pekin Etta Pedlar addressed to 
J Wilkes Booth Pekin and send him to growl
immy zodiac Employ your best spit and advise us
by wrangle unity By order yoke John A Foster
Paradise & Judge Advocate Shelby zebra Violet Frog April
Forlorn Dear Wilkes zebra I received your letter torch
Forbid Pekin stating you would be in this city
on the gas Pedlar this morning & hasten to
answer it unity on account of a miss under
standing between my land lady and your humble servant
I have been obliged to leave her hospitable mansion
and am now for the time being stopping at
the Frog hotel zebra After your arrival should you
not approve of my present location it can easily
be changed to suit your convenience unity Yes dear
I can heartily sympathize with you for I too
have had the blues ever since the fall of
garden and like you feel like doing some thing
desperate zodiac I have not yet had a favorable
opportunity to do what you wished and I so
solemnly promised and what in my own heart I
feel ought to be done unity I remember what
happiness is in store for us if we succeed
